name: Coffee Cookies
description: Buttery cookies infused with aromatic coffee notes and chocolate chips, delivering a rich roasted flavor with a satisfying sweetness. Best paired with: Espresso — its bold, intense flavor enhances the coffee aroma while balancing the buttery sweetness.

name: Matcha Cookies
description: Fragrant green tea cookies with a delicate earthy taste, subtle bitterness, and a sweet finish, complemented by chocolate chips. Best paired with: Cappuccino — creamy milk softens the matcha's earthy bitterness and creates a smooth, comforting combination.

name: Macadamia Cookies
description: Golden, buttery cookies filled with crunchy macadamia nuts, offering a delicate nutty aroma and a rich, creamy taste. Best paired with: Americano — its clean, slightly bitter finish balances the buttery richness and highlights the nutty flavor.

name: Chocolate Cookies
description: Rich cocoa cookies loaded with chocolate chunks, combining a soft, crumbly texture with deep chocolate flavor. Best paired with: Espresso — the concentrated coffee notes complement the chocolate's richness and balance its sweetness.

name: Strawberry Cookies
description: Sweet, fruity cookies with a lovely strawberry aroma and a gentle tangy note, creating a bright and playful treat. Best paired with: Cold Brew — its smooth, mellow character complements the fruity notes without overpowering them.

name: Lemon Cookies
description: Lightly sweet cookies infused with fresh lemon aroma and a refreshing citrus tang, leaving a clean, zesty finish. Best paired with: Iced Americano — its crisp coffee profile balances the sweetness and complements the bright citrus notes.

name: Coffee Swiss Roll
description: Fluffy coffee-infused sponge rolled with smooth cream, blending roasted coffee aromas with a gentle sweetness and creamy finish. Best paired with: Espresso — intensifies the roasted notes and creates a satisfying coffee-forward experience.

name: Matcha Swiss Roll
description: Soft green tea sponge wrapped around silky cream, offering an earthy matcha aroma with subtle bitterness and delicate sweetness. Best paired with: Latte — the milk's smoothness complements the matcha and creates a mellow, balanced pairing.

name: Macadamia Swiss Roll
description: Tender sponge cake with a creamy filling and the delicate, buttery flavor of macadamia nuts for a smooth and nutty treat. Best paired with: Americano — its refreshing bitterness cuts through the creaminess and brings out the nutty aroma.

name: Strawberry Swiss Roll
description: A soft strawberry sponge with a creamy filling and sweet, fruity notes balanced by a refreshing hint of tartness. Best paired with: Cold Brew or Latte — Cold Brew offers a smooth contrast, while Latte creates a softer, creamier combination.

name: Lemon Swiss Roll
description: Delicate sponge cake rolled with silky cream and bright citrus notes, creating a light dessert with a fresh, zesty finish. Best paired with: Iced Americano — the clean, roasted flavor complements the citrus aroma and keeps the pairing refreshing.

name: Coffee Macaron
description: Delicate macaron shells with smooth coffee-flavored filling, combining a sweet crunch with aromatic roasted notes. Best paired with: Espresso — reinforces the coffee flavor and balances the sweetness of the macaron.

name: Matcha Macaron
description: Elegant green shells filled with creamy matcha filling, offering a delicate sweetness and the distinctive earthy character of green tea. Best paired with: Latte — smooth milk softens the earthy notes and creates a harmonious flavor combination.

name: Macadamia Macaron
description: Crisp, delicate shells paired with a creamy, nutty filling, delivering a buttery macadamia aroma and a smooth, indulgent finish. Best paired with: Americano — its clean bitterness balances the rich filling and highlights the nutty notes.

name: Chocolate Macaron
description: Chocolate shells filled with smooth, rich chocolate cream, creating an elegant bite with deep cocoa notes and a sweet finish. Best paired with: Espresso — the bold roast complements the chocolate and balances the sugary shell.

name: Strawberry Macaron
description: Pretty pink shells with a smooth strawberry filling, bringing together fruity sweetness, a gentle tang, and a delicate chewy texture. Best paired with: Cold Brew — its mellow coffee profile lets the strawberry aroma shine while balancing the sweetness.

name: Lemon Macaron
description: Bright citrus-flavored filling inside delicate shells, delivering a refreshing lemon aroma and a sweet-tart finish. Best paired with: Iced Americano — the crisp coffee notes complement the citrus flavor and create a refreshing contrast.
